figures.finding: The Polish Film Institute (PISF) funds up to 50% of a film's budget (90% for a "difficult" film); its 2026 programmes allocate PLN 173.45 million to film production, PLN 70 million of it to fiction features and PLN 12 million to first features.

sources.said: 1. Limity procentowe dofinansowania zostały określone w § 7 Rozporządzenia i wynoszą do 50 % budżetu filmu w przypadku filmu zwykłego oraz do 90% budżetu filmu w przypadku Filmu trudnego. … II. Produkcja filmów fabularnych 70,00 … IV. Produkcja filmów dokumentalnych 19,50 173,45

figures.finding: Poland's audiovisual incentive refunds 30% of qualifying Polish spend, paid from the state budget first-come first-served until the year's pool runs out (at least 10% for animation); a fiction feature co-production must spend over PLN 4 million in Poland (a service production PLN 1 million), with a cultural test and caps per project and applicant.
